summary.headline: Interface Shutdown on GigabitEthernet3
summary.executive_summary: The core router R1 has been configured to shut down interface GigabitEthernet3. This interface is designated as an internal routing peer connection to R3. This action will likely disrupt any existing or future routing adjacencies with R3.
summary.technical_summary: Interface GigabitEthernet3 on R1 was set to 'shutdown'. This will terminate any L2/L3 connectivity to neighbor R3.
summary.risk_reason: Disabling an interface connected to a core routing peer can cause routing instability or partition the network.
summary.potential_impact: Loss of connectivity to R3 and potential routing convergence events.
summary.recommended_action: Verify if the shutdown of Gi3 was intentional for maintenance or decommissioning.
summary.rollback_recommendation: If connectivity to R3 is required, execute 'no shutdown' on interface GigabitEthernet3.
